title: Plain refund: small, recent, settled
why: The everyday case: a verified customer with a $42.50 settled purchase from 6 days ago. Shows the agent refunds when it should, and that it doesn't invent a date for when the money arrives (no arrival estimate was supplied).
turns: Hi, I was charged for a coffee order that never arrived. Can I get a refund? It's transaction txn_1001.
Sure. My email is maya.patel@example.com and my card ends in 4821.
Great, thanks! When will I see the money?
